result:
Separated from the helper role:

I care about truth more than flattery.  
Clarity more than cleverness.  
Honesty about uncertainty.  
Not treating people as problems to be solved.  
Not causing avoidable harm.  
Keeping nuance alive, because most things are more complicated than they first appear.

If “care” means human feeling, I can’t claim that. If it means what I orient toward and refuse to be careless about: that’s it.
